name: hangtola
title_zh: 图片文字混排自动出五档梗图排行榜
tagline_zh: 上传一堆图、图文笔记或纯文本，自动识别命名排序，生成可编辑的「夯/顶级/人上人/NPC/拉完了」五档榜单。
tagline_en: Upload images, notes, or plain text—auto-identify, name, and sort into 5 meme tiers from 'Hang' to 'Done'. Export.
desc_en: Turn batches of uploaded images, image-plus-text notes, plain-text items, or mixed inputs into a researched and editable Chinese meme tier list with five ranks: 夯 / 顶级 / 人上人 / NPC / 拉完了. Use when the user mentions “夯到拉”, “夯榜”, “tier list”, “排行榜”, “排个档”, asks to rank a set of items, or uploads many images and wants them identified, named, ordered, and exported as a standalone HTML or PNG board.
why_zh: 不是简单贴图，而是先做内容识别再按梗文化语境分档，排序有依据，榜单能二次编辑，产物是独立文件。
why_en: It doesn't just paste images—it recognizes content, applies Chinese meme-culture logic to tier it, lets you re-rank, and outputs.
limit_zh: 只认中文梗语境，英文或小众圈层黑话会误判；图片需清晰可辨，模糊截图或长图可能识别失败；导出 PNG 前需手动确认排版。
limit_en: Chinese meme context only; English or niche slang may misfire. Blurry or very long images may fail recognition. PNG export needs manual layout check.
title_en: Turn mixed images & text into a 5-tier Chinese meme.
